scope: Implemented local Computer/Watch/Tasks/Devices UI. Missing cross-machine and multi-window capabilities are listed separately, not counted as implemented.

evidence.visual_hierarchy: Agent remains first; one primary action per page.
evidence.spacing_layout: 1440x900 and 390x844; aligned stage and readable side context.
evidence.typography: Existing serif headings and restrained interface text.
evidence.component_polish: Real empty, approval, error and module states; no synthetic activity.
evidence.color_harmony: Shared neutral/terracotta tokens; light and dark contrast checked.
evidence.consistency: Shared shell, logo, controls and state badges.
evidence.responsive_robustness: Navigation, controls and history remain available without horizontal overflow.
evidence.usability_accessibility: Keyboard routes, focus, labelled forms and Axe gates verified.
